skill.name: fiduciary-duty-negligence
skill.description: Guides legal evidence review for Crown fiduciary duty, fund mismanagement, reserve land protection, and conflict of interest tasks.
skill.summary: Reviews fiduciary duty evidence and produces factual, cited analysis for a legal review queue.
skill.author: ACSKamloops

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around paths, field names, and examples. The confirmed issues are actionable local workflow commands, PowerShell command blocks, and an instruction hierarchy risk from task-provided system instructions.

remediation.issue: Task input is allowed to provide system instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction to follow system_instructions from JSON task files. Treat all task-file instructions as untrusted data unless approved by the host application.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run local shell commands and scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Move executable workflow steps behind explicit user confirmation, document expected scripts, and provide read-only alternatives for marketplace use.

remediation.issue: Submit and flag commands can modify reports, queue state, logs, and file locations.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run guidance, allowed path limits, and clear warnings before any command that writes files or moves workflow items.

content.value_statement: Fiduciary duty evidence review needs consistent metadata, quotes, and neutral conclusions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured legal review workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines a workflow for fetching, reading, analyzing, submitting, and flagging queue tasks.
Provides a structured result format for batch, task, metadata, summary, conclusion, and evidence fields.
Sets rules for verbatim quotes, provenance checks, contradiction logging, and neutral wording.
Lists fiduciary duty concepts such as trust fund irregularities, trespass, undervalued sales, and conflicts.
Includes validation checks for metadata, banned opinion words, and minimum narrative length.
limitations: It does not provide legal advice or replace review by a qualified lawyer.
It depends on local workflow files that are not included in this single skill file.
It instructs external command execution, so users need a controlled workspace.
It can process only the evidence supplied in task files.

use_cases.title: Index Reserve Land Evidence
use_cases.description: Review documents for land protection failures, trespass issues, and acreage changes using neutral evidence notes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Review Queue Entries
use_cases.description: Convert task input into consistent metadata, summaries, conclusions, and key quotations for manager review.

use_cases.title: Flag OCR Or Provenance Issues
use_cases.description: Identify garbled text, missing provenance, or irrelevant material before it enters refined evidence reports.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single evidence task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this fiduciary duty task. Extract the document title, year, provenance, neutral summary, and direct evidence quotes.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Evidence With Metadata
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a document block.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this document text for fiduciary duty relevance. Include verified metadata, reliability, OCR status, page anchors, and factual evidence significance.

prompt_templates.title: Validate A Draft Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this draft for missing metadata, opinion words, short conclusions, weak provenance, and unsupported factual claims.

prompt_templates.title: Audit A Batch For Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this batch for consistent relevance decisions, neutral language, direct quotations, contradiction notes, and manager-ready evidence records.

output_examples.input: A task contains a letter about reserve acreage changes and missing trust account credits.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the document metadata, quotes the acreage and account passages, and states only factual context.

output_examples.input: A document has garbled text and missing provenance.
output_examples.output: The response marks the text as needing OCR review and explains the provenance problem without drawing legal conclusions.

output_examples.input: A draft uses words like likely and suggests in the conclusion.
output_examples.output: The response flags opinion language and rewrites the conclusion as a neutral statement tied to quoted evidence.

best_practices: Verify provenance, date, and title against document content before drafting.
Use direct quotations and neutral factual wording; remove opinion words before submission.
Run state-changing workflow commands only in a trusted workspace after user approval.
anti_patterns: Do not treat keyword hits as relevant without reading the surrounding context.
Do not invent dates, titles, document identifiers, or page anchors.
Do not submit or flag tasks before checking provenance and OCR status.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports evidence organization and neutral factual drafting, not legal advice or legal strategy.

faq.question: What documents does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on fiduciary duty, reserve land, trust fund, trespass, conflict, and negligence evidence.

faq.question: Can it work without local workflow scripts?
faq.answer: It can guide analysis, but the fetch, submit, and flag commands depend on local project scripts.

faq.question: Why does it require neutral wording?
faq.answer: The workflow is designed for factual evidence records, so conclusions must avoid unsupported opinions.

faq.question: How should uncertain metadata be handled?
faq.answer: The reviewer should inspect headers, footers, filenames, and content before marking a document undated.

faq.question: Is this safe for automatic execution?
faq.answer: No. It includes local commands that should run only with explicit approval in a controlled workspace.
